scope: One real public visitor WebSocket conversation with a synthetic prerecorded microphone question; actual ASR, agent response, read-only shipment tool and incoming speech audio. A human microphone and subjective voice quality were not assessed.

messages.text: Hello, I'm Nora, an AI assistant in a fictional logistics demo. We have one minute. Ask about shipment HV-2048 or Gate A.
Please look up shipment HV-2048. What is its current status?
This shipment is currently on customs hold and its estimated time of arrival is November ninth, two thousand twenty-six at eight thirty AM CET.
